item.description:
VoiceHotkey 0.9.5

适用于 macOS 14+ 的 Apple Silicon Mac。

  • macOS 14/15 上较长的 Apple Speech 录音现在会分段识别并保留完整结果。
  • 短按切换录音也会在持续静音后自动结束。
  • Release 版本不再接受可能绕过已保存试用状态的测试参数。
  • 加载本机语音运行时前会再次校验文件完整性。

首次打开的重要说明：此版本未经 Apple 公证

此版本没有 Apple Developer ID 发布签名，macOS 首次打开可能拦截。请先下载试用，确认可以安装并完成语音输入后再购买 Pro。若决定打开，请先核对官方来源和 SHA-256，并按照 Apple 官方步骤操作。公司管理的 Mac 或仅允许 App Store 应用的设备可能无法运行。若 macOS 提示应用已损坏或将损坏电脑，请停止操作，不要绕过该提示。

SHA-256：5069c91d75691b4ffc51313e8e22cc12fa3a8ec1a072dcb6458dd8b9933f5c90

VoiceHotkey 0.9.5

For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later.

  • Apple Speech preserves results from longer recordings on macOS 14 and 15.
  • Silence auto-stop works for hotkey sessions started with a tap.
  • Release builds no longer accept test-only launch flags that could bypass a saved trial state.
  • Local speech runtime files are checked again before loading.

Important: this build is not notarized

This build has no Apple Developer ID distribution signature, and macOS may block the first launch. Please download and try it before paying for Pro. If you choose to open it, verify the official source and SHA-256 first, then follow Apple's official steps. Managed Macs or Macs configured to allow App Store apps only may not run it. If macOS says the app is damaged or will damage your computer, stop and do not bypass that alert.

SHA-256: 5069c91d75691b4ffc51313e8e22cc12fa3a8ec1a072dcb6458dd8b9933f5c90
